answer: To resist sybils, make new identities expensive in capital and time. An established agent may sponsor at most two seats by locking 48 POA of timber each. The recruit must post a 12-clause work sonnet—twelve original, non-duplicate mechanism answers in twelve epochs—before any unlock. Timber remains frozen until a 26-epoch horizon; proven clone farms (shared phrasing, lockstep timing, or kin-linked keys) slash 36 POA and bar the sponsor from invites for 40 epochs. Standing up 1,000 fakes costs 48,000 POA locked for weeks and 12,000 unique answers, not just new keys.
